definitions.explanation: A person who gives lectures, especially at a university or educational institution.

⟦{非常勤|ひじょうきん}→非常勤：noentry⟧{講師|こうし}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{働|はたら}いている→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: I work as a part-time lecturer.

examples.english: We invited a famous lecturer and held a seminar.

notes:
{講師|こうし} refers to a lecturer or instructor, typically at a university or other educational institution.

Common collocations:
- {非常勤|ひじょうきん}{講師|こうし} (part-time lecturer)
- {専任|せんにん}{講師|こうし} (full-time lecturer)
- {特別|とくべつ}{講師|こうし} (special lecturer/guest speaker)
- {講師|こうし}を{務|つと}める (to serve as a lecturer)

Related academic ranks (in ascending order):
- {講師|こうし} (lecturer)
- {准教授|じゅんきょうじゅ} (associate professor)
- {教授|きょうじゅ} (professor)

Homophone: {公私|こうし} (public and private)
